description: UK capital allowances on plant and machinery: Annual Investment Allowance up to £1m a year; for companies from 1 April 2023 full expensing (100%, main rate) or 50% first year allowance (special rate); 40% first year allowance on main-rate assets from 1 January 2026 (leased assets allowed); writing down allowances 14% main pool (from April 2026, 18% before) and 6% special rate pool, with a reducing-balance schedule. Cars get only writing down allowances; cash-basis sole traders deduct equipment as an expense. United Kingdom, as of 2026-11-21 (gov.uk and legislation.gov.uk). Income Tax bands are for England, Wales and Northern Ireland; Scottish bands are not calculated. General information and estimates only; not personal tax advice, no agent services and no filing with HMRC.
